title: Add Quotation CRUD regression coverage
description: Close the audited Quotation generic CRUD test gap using the existing EF Quotation workflow. Add focused non-production tests for create/update/detail/list validation and server-side total recalculation. Do not change production schema, deployment, OSS, or credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Quotation create and update paths have focused regression tests for authoritative server-side total recalculation.
Detail and list/query behavior have focused coverage for normal and invalid inputs.
Existing Inquiry/PI/Sales Order conversion and quotation governance behavior remains unchanged.
No production schema, deployment, OSS, credential, or irreversible data operation is introduced.
Safe validation passes; browser/UI acceptance remains deferred during feature development.

scenarios: Create and edit a quotation and verify persisted totals and detail values.

human_gate.reason: Regression coverage and existing application behavior only; no production schema or external mutation.
